author: awesome_apricot
body:
I am apricot and i used to be staff and stuff and yeah i left like a year ago but i am coming back for some top banter with the lads and maybe a cheeky nandos?!?!!11? anyone? 

anyway where did all my friends go on my profile and why has everyone changed their names? >:(

This is also an ama so hit me up with some Q's bbz

Just for the record I don't usually write like that, I don't really know what came across me.. 

Rough translation: I am awesome_apricot and I used to be a member of the staff team. I departed nearly a year ago; for my exams. They are nearly over now (one left >:D). I am returning for some fun times with my fellow Avicadians and would possibly enjoy a meeting in which we indulged our selves in a semi fast food chain, by thy name of "Nando's".

peace
